title: International Baccalaureate Diploma in Teaching and Learning (Level 6)
description: The purpose of this program is to professionally and individually develop self-reflective educators who can meet the evolving demands of the teaching profession and thrive in a constantly changing educational landscape.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and OTHM UK
longDescription: The purpose of this International Baccalaureate Diploma in Teaching and Learning (Level 6) is to professionally and individually develop self-reflective educators capable of meeting the evolving demands of the education sector and thriving in a constantly changing world. This course enhances your ability to understand educational challenges, analyze teaching practices, and develop effective solutions. It introduces fundamental concepts essential to understanding how educational systems function, ensuring that whether you pursue further studies or advance in your teaching career, you will excel with a critically developed understanding of the key skills needed to succeed in the field of education. This International Baccalaureate Diploma in Teaching and Learning (Level 6) serves as a foundation for further education in education and teaching while enhancing employment opportunities in the field. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 120 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: Each module consists of 40 guided learning hours of material with an additional 30-50 hours worth of optional materials which comprise of recommended exercises, recommended readings and internet resources. Within the modules are self-testing exercises. You must take care in answering these. Although they are not marked nor do they count towards your final assessment, the marking is tested against your scoring on the final assessment to check for consistency of score. Successful completion of the full Level 6 Baccalaureate Diploma in Teaching and Learning will equip students with the credentials to pursue careers in education, teaching leadership, curriculum design, instructional coordination, or educational consultancy.

entry: For entry into Level 6 International Higher Diploma in Teaching and Learning, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership, or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: After completing this Level 6 endorsed qualification, students can progress to a variety of university courses that align with their academic and career goals or potential university progression pathways.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
